why_ai: Screen-based review that classifiers already absorb, leaving humans only the hard contextual cases.
why_clarity: Policy rulebook and massive repetition, but literal agreement differs from contextual correctness.
why_digital: Reviewers judge digital media on client tools, delivered remotely and offshore.

why_ai: Linking decisions to downstream outcomes is data analysis that software can perform.
why_clarity: What quality even means is contested between auditor agreement and real outcomes.
why_digital: Decision logs and outcome data analysed and reported on screen.

why_ai: Vendor carries occupational liability and clinical judgement on reviewer harm stays human.
why_clarity: Psychological harm surfaces slowly and safe exposure has no agreed measure.
why_digital: Exposure is measured in software but clinical care reaches people directly.

why_ai: Deciding which items need a human is a routing and classification problem.
why_clarity: Routing accuracy is measurable in weeks against human-needed labels.
why_digital: Queue items classified and routed entirely in software.

why_ai: Scarce speakers and data keep humans needed where offline harm from errors is severe.
why_clarity: Policy exists, but failures show up as offline harm long after decisions.
why_digital: Remote review of digital content by language speakers anywhere.

why_ai: Adjudicated-example training and policy updates are content that AI can generate and deliver.
why_clarity: Consistency is measurable, but the policy meaning lives in examples not the document.
why_digital: Policy documents and examples, delivered partly in classrooms at vendor sites.

why_ai: Display controls automate easily, but clinical calibration of safe dose stays human.
why_clarity: Controls are concrete, but whether they prevent harm emerges over a career.
why_digital: Image and video fidelity controls applied inside review software.

why_ai: Sampling, re-review and consistency checking are directly automatable.
why_clarity: Audits score decisions against written policy on sampled items routinely.
why_digital: Re-reviewing digital decisions and compiling reports on screen.

why_ai: Contracted review capacity priced per decision is what automated moderation replaces first.
why_clarity: Throughput and turnaround are measured exactly across huge volumes.
why_digital: Offshore review capacity sold remotely to platforms.

why_ai: Counselling and wellness protection depend on human relationships and employer liability.
why_clarity: Whether promised protections are delivered is hard to observe or measure.
why_digital: Reviewers work on screens but counselling and wellness support is partly in person.

why_ai: Forecasting and rostering are solved problems that software performs.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checked daily against actual volume.
why_digital: Volume data in, rosters out, all in planning software.
